quote: If a highway has been designed to provide a single right lane to be used only for turning, a vehicle must: While being driven in the right turn lane, not travel through an intersection.

activation.condition: Highway designed with one right lane used only for turning; vehicle driven in that lane.

obligation.description: Vehicle in that right turn lane must not travel through an intersection.

timing.description: During original lane occupancy and intersection entry/departure.
